title: Local speech
description: Deterministic local CPU speech. Text mode speaks a sentence; words mode assigns each positive Notes event to the next word and maps MIDI pitch to voice pitch (the flite engine sings each word at one steady pitch: kal16 from 50 to 480 Hz, slt from 74 to 650, rms from 55 to 450 and awb from 114 to 486; a note outside that range is sung the same note an octave or more away).

parameters.name: engine
parameters.doc: Speech renderer variant. humanico (the default) is the provisional local Klatt candidate; retro is versioned retro/formant-2; flite is a translation of Flite from Carnegie Mellon University with four voices (see voice).

parameters.name: voice
parameters.doc: Voice of the flite engine. kal16 is a diphone voice (the default; it also speaks phonemes and sings in words mode); slt (US English, female), rms (US English, male) and awb (Scottish English, male) are statistical voices that speak text, with the markup, own pronunciations and spelling, and sing in words mode, but speak no phonemes. Write it only together with engine flite.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.doc: text for ordinary speech or words for Notes-driven word-per-note speech.

parameters.name: duration_policy
parameters.doc: In words mode: natural keeps speech duration, gate crops at note length, fit accelerates up to 2x before cropping.

parameters.name: text
parameters.doc: Text to speak. It must not be empty: leave the line out instead. Give text or phonemes, never both. With engine flite in text mode the text may carry tags: <pitch 220>word</pitch> (Hz from 50 to 480, or <pitch +3st> semitones above pitch_hz), <rate 1.3>words</rate> (0.25 to 4, 1 is the rate of the block), <range 25>words</range> (Hz, how far the pitch moves), <emph>word</emph> (higher and longer) and <break 300ms/> (a pause of exactly that length, up to 5 s); write < for a < that is not a tag.

parameters.name: phonemes
parameters.doc: Optional space-separated CMU-style phonemes with vowel stress, for example HH AH0 L OW1. Use instead of text, never together with it, and never empty. Only the voice kal16 speaks phonemes (the voices slt, rms and awb speak text); it speaks them as one utterance, as flite -p does, with no phrasing: the digits only choose its reduced vowels (AH0 is its schwa, ER0 its r-coloured schwa), so phonemes sound flatter than text.

parameters.name: rate
parameters.doc: Authored speaking rate, where 1 is the reference rate.

parameters.name: fit_max_rate
parameters.doc: Words mode fit ceiling: absolute effective rate, from authored rate up to 2.

parameters.name: pitch_hz
parameters.doc: Reference voice pitch in text mode. The flite engine uses 95 Hz when the block does not write one, and the voices slt, rms and awb the mean pitch of their own recording (as flite does): when the block writes none, the voice sounds exactly as in flite.

parameters.name: pitch_range
parameters.doc: How far the pitch of the flite engine moves around pitch_hz: 0 is a flat voice. When the block writes none, the voice keeps its own range (11 Hz for kal16, the range of the recording for slt, rms and awb). Write it only together with engine flite.

parameters.name: lead_trim
parameters.doc: Drops the silence that the flite voice puts before the first word, so that a line starts on the beat (1 ms is kept; the word timings follow). Write it only together with engine flite.

parameters.name: pause_scale
parameters.doc: Scales the pauses between the words of the flite voice (commas, sentence ends): 1 leaves them, 0 removes them, 2 doubles them. Write it only together with engine flite.

parameters.name: brightness
parameters.doc: Brightens the flite voice: a high shelf above 3.5 kHz after the resampling, for the 16 kHz voice that sounds duller than the others. 0 leaves the sound as it is. Write it only together with engine flite.

parameters.name: lexicon
parameters.doc: Own pronunciations for the flite voice: entries 'word = PHONEMES' separated by ; (for example tomato = T AH0 M EY1 T OW0; ample = AE1 M P AH0 L). Every vowel carries a stress digit 0, 1 or 2 (the voice knows two stresses, 2 is read as 1), AX needs none. A word is matched without regard to case, in the words of the text. Write it only together with engine flite and a text.

parameters.name: spell
parameters.doc: Words that the flite voice reads letter by letter, separated by spaces (for example cpu usb), or all for every word of the text. A word of the lexicon cannot be spelled. Write it only together with engine flite and a text.

parameters.name: level
parameters.doc: matched (the default) adds a fixed offset per engine to the gain, so that retro, Humanico and Flite are equally loud at the same gain (measured with EBU R128 on 20 sentences). engine keeps the loudness that each engine makes.

parameters.name: gain
parameters.doc: Deterministic output gain applied after speech mixing.

parameters.name: reference_midi
parameters.doc: MIDI note mapped to reference_hz in words mode.

parameters.name: reference_hz
parameters.doc: Voice frequency at reference_midi in words mode. When it is not written, pitch_hz is used (the flite engine: 95 Hz).
